title: Product Compass: Monthly Exec Pulse and Decision Clauses for Runtime Economics
creator: Sofia Chen
description: Context: This ticket captures the materials and decision slate for the monthly executive pulse focused on runtime economics. Objective is to present a concise view of trade-offs across latency, unit cost, and reliability, secure direction on two near-term investment lanes, and a funding/commitment ask for dedicated capacity pilots. Deliverables: (1) One-page pre-read for execs, (2) 12-slide compact deck with signal visuals, (3) decision record with acceptance criteria and rollout plan. Key questions: A) Approve reallocation of $750k 6-month reserved capacity budget to northern-region dedicated pools? B) Prioritize batching v2 (+KV-persistent cache) over model-quantization push in Q2? C) Approve go/no-go criteria for canary rollout to customer tier 'enterprise' with fallback policy?
agenda: 1) 3-min signal summary (cost / latency / error trends) 2) Proposal A: Dedicated capacity reallocation (ask + supporting perf curves) 3) Proposal B: Investment priority trade space (batching v2 vs quantization) 4) Rollout guardrails and monitoring ask 5) Decision asks and next steps
success_criteria: 1) Execs record explicit choices for the three asks 2) Finance signs preliminary commitment for $750k pilot 3) Eng leadership approves canary SLA and monitoring dashboard queries 4) PM to publish decision record within 48 hours
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Dedicated capacity reallocation may reduce burst capacity window and increase tail latency for small customers. Mitigation: Maintain 20% burst buffer and enable automated fallback to hosted variant for affected routes. Risk: Batching v2 complexity increases KG cache coherency bugs. Mitigation: staged rollout with extended canary and crash-only testing harness; dedicated incident runbook and ICE (index change) alerting.
decision_record_template: Decision ID: PM-918272-DEC1 | Ask: [approve/reject] | Rationale: [summary] | Metrics to monitor: [p90 latency, avg cost/token, error-rate] | Rollout plan: [canary %, duration, rollback criteria] | Owner: [name] | Publish date: [YYYY-MM-DD]
